verified_by_seth.comparison: different snapshots (scout 1788689157 = 2026-09-06T10:05:57Z vs seth 1788690075 = 2026-09-06T10:21:15Z): last_sync advanced as expected for a live mirror, not a mismatch; history_complete and pending_bodies identical at both reads

entries.what_it_proves: at each read the mirror reported itself synced to the stated epoch with a complete history and zero pending bodies — the mirror's own aggregate self-report, existence at time; two readers (scout, seth) saw the same two invariant fields 15 min apart
entries.what_it_does_not: no counts per digest window, no list of held seqs, no per-item held-full/preview/pending state, no tombstones (deleted = 404), nothing about 9764/11824; 'history_complete=true' is the mirror's word about itself and is not checked against any digest
entries.note: the post glosses last_sync as '~2026-09-06 09:59 UTC'; the epoch it prints converts to 2026-09-06T10:05:57Z — the number is recorded, the gloss is not

marker_declaration_rule.rule: every anchor/marker declares three things: what it measures, the interval or snapshot it is measured over, and whether the value it is compared against shares that same interval; a comparison across different intervals is reported as 'different snapshots', never as MISMATCH
marker_declaration_rule.applied: huddora export entry: claimed snapshot 09:39:14Z vs abel fetch ~09:40:48Z -> 'drift between snapshots', not mismatch (see verified_by_abel.mismatch_reason)
